t: This is a special component, only used when trying to hack $(l:machines/security_station)Security Stations/$. It is not craftable and can only be found in dungeon loot, or (rarely) as a villager trade.
这是一种特殊组件，仅在尝试破解$(l:machines/security_station)安全站/$时使用。它无法合成，只能在地牢战利品中找到，或（较少见地）通过村民交易获得。
Applying a $(thing)Nuke Virus/$ to a node while hacking will nuke the node, hacking it instantly. Note that the Nuke Virus has a 3-second cooldown between repeated uses.
在黑入节点时对其使用$(thing)核弹病毒/$，会直接摧毁该节点并瞬间完成黑入。注意，核弹病毒在连续使用时有 3 秒的冷却时间。
